subject: Hosted plan amendment: burst window & monthly commit changes
body:
From: Ella Martin <ella@streamwave.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>
Subject: Request: short-term commit increase + burst window smoothing

Hi Rachel,

We're seeing an expected Q3 product ramp (campaigns go live in early July) and need to discuss topping up our hosted API commit for July–September. Current monthly commit is 350k tokens; projected peak months could hit ~1.1M tokens/month with concentrated daily bursts.

Two asks:
- Can we do a short-term increase for Jul–Sep to 1.2M tokens/month (with an option to roll into a 12-month commit)?
- During the burst windows, our ops team is concerned about per-route rate limits that slow down concurrent user flows. Can we smooth rate limit behavior (i.e. temporary burst allowance and graceful throttling) so sessions don’t see dropped requests?

Attached a Q2 usage snapshot for context (StreamWave_UsageDashboard_Q2.pdf).

Thanks — let me know what options and timelines look like.

Best,
Ella
Head of Platform, StreamWave

-----
From: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
To: Ella Martin <ella@streamwave.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Subject: Re: Request: short-term commit increase + burst window smoothing

Hi Ella — thanks for the heads-up and the dashboard. We can definitely support a temporary top-up and put a plan in place to convert into a committed uplift if StreamWave prefers predictability.

High-level options I recommend:
1) Short-term top-up (Jul–Sep): increase hosted monthly commit to 1.2M tokens, normal per-token pricing with an Addendum for the 3-month term. Fastest path — 3 business days to provision after sign-off.
2) 12-month uplift: commit to 1.2M tokens/month for 12 months for a 10% blended discount and an SLA tweak for rate smoothing during defined burst windows. Requires a 10–14 day legal/procurement cycle.
3) Burst add-on: keep base commit at 350k, add a burst pool (400k tokens/day cap) with higher transient rate limits and PAYG overage pricing for true spikes.

I'll pull in Marissa and Pricing to confirm margins and SLA language. Can you confirm calendar weeks you expect the heaviest traffic and whether procurement prefers a one-off amendment or an annual commitment?

Regards,
Rachel
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

-----
From: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>
Subject: FW: Request: short-term commit increase + burst window smoothing

Marissa / Nikhil — forwarding StreamWave's request. Key asks: near-term top-up to 1.2M/mo + smoothing for burst windows. Attached a draft amendment (Hosted_Tier_Amendment_Draft_20270620.docx) with three options outlined and redline placeholders for SLA/rate-limit behavior.

Quick numbers for counsel:
- Current price: $0.00012/token (hosted)
- Option 1 (3mo top-up): 1.2M tokens/mo x 3 months => revenue delta = ~246k tokens * $0.00012 = $29,520 (approx).
- Option 2 (12mo uplift, 10% discount): 1.2M tokens/mo x 12 months at $0.000108/token => ARR uplift = $155,520 (approx).
- Option 3 (burst add-on PAYG): estimated 3-month revenue unpredictable but lower immediate ARR; useful if procurement resists commit.

My recommendation: prioritize Option 2 if we can get legal to sign within 2 weeks; otherwise Option 1 for speed. Need pricing sign-off on discounting and legal to scope burst smoothing language.

Can you advise on feasible SLA language for temporary burst allowances (e.g., allow 2x baseline per-route QPS for 30-minute windows with soft-fail throttling thereafter)?

Thanks — putting a placeholder in calendar for a quick sync Mon 14th if you’re free.

Rachel

-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 14:30:00 -0700
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>
Cc: Legal Intake <legal@redwood.ai>
Subject: Re: FW: Request: short-term commit increase + burst window smoothing

All — saw the numbers. I approve offering Option 2 (12-month uplift with 10% blended discount) to StreamWave on the condition we:
- Lock a 6-week implementation window for rate-limit changes (engineering to schedule maintenance windows);
- Add an explicit burst smoothing clause: allow 2x per-route QPS for up to 60 minutes per day per region, with graceful 429s after thresholds and a shared incident channel for escalation.
- Provide a one-time onboarding credit of $2,500 to offset integration effort.

Nikhil: can you confirm margin impact and whether we should cap daily burst tokens to avoid undue risk? Legal — please prepare a short addendum that captures the burst clause and billing term (12 months).

Marissa
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference

-----
From: Ella Martin <ella@streamwave.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -0700
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@streamwave.ai>
Subject: Re: Request: short-term commit increase + burst window smoothing

Hi Rachel / Marissa,

Thanks — StreamWave is aligned to proceed with Option 2 (12-month uplift to 1.2M tokens/mo with the 10% discount). Procurement confirms the billing contact (procurement@streamwave.ai). Please send the DocuSign link for the addendum and the final SLA language for review. We expect to flip this by end of next week if legal/procurement sign off quickly.

Two quick asks:
- Can we get the burst smoothing clause to include a suggested implementation date window (target week of July 5)?
- Please include the onboarding credit on the first invoice.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Ella
Head of Platform, StreamWave

Attachments referenced: StreamWave_UsageDashboard_Q2.pdf, Hosted_Tier_Amendment_Draft_20270620.docx
